classifications.rationale: FocusTrace does not currently test whether authored CSS or script locks operation to a single display orientation.
FocusTrace reviews generic interactive elements and observed pointer actions lacking keyboard reachability, intersecting focus-order semantics without reproducing axe's exact static role test.
FocusTrace reports actionable hidden/focus mismatches rather than enumerating all hidden content, so it covers only the accessibility-relevant subset of this review-item rule.
FocusTrace explicitly implements the text-content subset of ACT 2ee8b8 and excludes CSS-generated text, images of text and broader visual-label inference.

FocusTrace now uses a conservative font-size plus font-weight heuristic to surface short paragraph text that may be visually functioning as a heading. Because visual intent cannot be proven statically, the result remains REVIEW and only overlaps the benchmark heuristic.
FocusTrace does not yet infer visually caption-like table content that should use caption markup.
FocusTrace does not yet calculate header associations for data cells in larger tables.
